_comment: Shared destructive-command gate patterns. Deploy via playbook 44_deploy_gate_patterns.yml. Edit here; both bash-gate.py and kiss-dispatcher/tools.mjs load this file at runtime with hardcoded fallback.

bash_block_patterns.reason: pct destroy permanently deletes an LXC container
qm destroy permanently deletes a VM
lvremove destroys an LVM logical volume
vgremove destroys an LVM volume group
pvremove destroys an LVM physical volume
wipefs erases filesystem signatures on a block device
mkfs formats a filesystem, erasing all data
dd to /dev/* overwrites raw disk data
shred on /dev/* destroys raw disk data
zpool destroy removes a ZFS pool and all its data
zfs destroy -r/-R recursively destroys datasets
rm -rf / would destroy the root filesystem
rm -rf /etc destroys system configuration
rm -rf /home destroys all user data
rm -rf /opt destroys all services
rm -rf /var destroys logs and databases
rm -rf $HOME destroys the user home directory
DROP DATABASE permanently destroys a database
DROP SCHEMA permanently destroys a schema and its data
pvesm remove destroys a Proxmox storage definition
